mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom tiny home and a pre-built model?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom tiny home is designed from scratch to meet your exact specifications, offering complete control over the layout, materials, and features. This results in a truly personalized space optimized for your lifestyle. A pre-built model, conversely, is constructed based on a standardized floor plan and material selection, often with limited customization options. While pre-built models can be faster and potentially less expensive upfront, custom designs provide unparalleled flexibility and ensure your tiny home is unique and perfectly suited to your needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom tiny homes are uniquely designed to your specifications, while pre-built models use standardized plans with limited customization. Custom designs offer full control and personalization.
